sourceMap={};if(!episodeList||episodeList.length==0){sourceMap['默认']=[{name:'第一集',url:baseUrl}];sendSourceMap(sourceMap);return}sourceMap['默认']=Array.from(episodeList).map((item)=>({name:item.textContent,url:baseUrl+'?data-vid='+item.getAttribute('data-vid'),}));sendSourceMap(sourceMap)}function netIntercept(){sniffLog('拦截启动');const _getImageData=CanvasRenderingContext2D.prototype.getImageData;CanvasRenderingContext2D.prototype.getImageData=function(...args){const results={videoSrc:null,videoCurrentSrc:null,sourceSrc:[],history:[],};let lastSrc=null;let lastCurrentSrc=null;let originalXhrOpen;let hasFound=false;let checkVideoTimer=null;let videoObserver=null;function readXhrContent(xhr){if(xhr.readyState!==4)return'';if(xhr.responseType===''||xhr.responseType==='text'){return xhr.responseText||''}if(xhr.responseType==='arraybuffer'){try{const decoder=new TextDecoder('utf-8');return decoder.decode(xhr.response)}catch(e){return''}}return''}function stopIntercept(){if(checkVideoTimer){clearInterval(checkVideoTimer);checkVideoTimer=null}if(originalXhrOpen){window.XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open=originalXhrOpen}sniffLog('结束请求拦截')}originalXhrOpen=window.XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open;window.XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open=function(...args){const url=args[1];sniffLog('XHR捕获: '+JSON.stringify(url));const xhr=this;xhr.addEventListener('readystatechange',()=>{if(hasFound)return;if(xhr.readyState!==4)return;try{const content=readXhrContent(xhr);if(content.trim().startsWith('#EXTM3U')){hasFound=true;sendPlayUrl(url);stopIntercept()}}catch(e){sniffLog('XHR读取失败: '+JSON.stringify(e))}});return originalXhrOpen.apply(this,args)};function checkVideo(){sniffLog('start checkVideo');const v=document.querySelector('video');if(!v)return;if(v.src&&v.src!==lastSrc){lastSrc=v.src;results.videoSrc=v.src;results.history.push({type:'src',url:v.src,time:Date.now()});if(!v.src.startsWith('blob:')){sendPlayUrl(v.src)}}if(v.currentSrc&&v.currentSrc!==lastCurrentSrc){lastCurrentSrc=v.currentSrc;results.videoCurrentSrc=v.currentSrc;results.history.push({type:'currentSrc',url:v.currentSrc,time:Date.now(),});if(!v.currentSrc.startsWith('blob:')){sendPlayUrl(v.currentSrc)}}v.querySelectorAll('source').forEach((s,i)=>{if(s.src&&results.sourceSrc[i]!==s.src){results.sourceSrc[i]=s.src;results.history.push({type:'source',url:s.src,time:Date.now(),});if(!s.src.startsWith('blob:')){sendPlayUrl(s.src)}}})}checkVideo();checkVideoTimer=setInterval(checkVideo,500);document.addEventListener('loadedmetadata',(e)=>{if(e.target.tagName==='VIDEO')checkVideo()},true,);document.addEventListener('loadstart',(e)=>{if(e.target.tagName==='VIDEO')checkVideo()},true,);document.addEventListener('durationchange',(e)=>{if(e.target.tagName==='VIDEO')checkVideo()},true,);const observer=new MutationObserver(()=>checkVideo());observer.observe(document.documentElement,{childList:true,subtree:true,attributes:true,attributeFilter:['src'],});window.__GET_MEDIA__=()=>JSON.stringify(results)}netIntercept();async function sniffPlayUrl(){const params=new URLSearchParams(location.search);const vid=params.get('data-vid');if(vid){const link=document.querySelector('a.multilink-btn[data-vid='+vid+']',);link.click();await new Promise((r)=>setTimeout(r,3000))}}function waitForElement(selector,maxRetry=10,intervalMs=200){return new Promise((resolve)=>{let count=0;function poll(){const el=document.querySelector(selector);if(el){resolve(el);return}count++;if(count>=maxRetry){resolve(null);return}setTimeout(poll,intervalMs)}poll()})}function getId(uri){const url=new URL(uri);const path=url.pathname;const filename=path.split('/').pop();return filename.replace('.html','')}window.taskSniffResource=function(keyword){sniffLog('开始执行任务：获取资源信息');sniffResource(keyword);sniffLog('任务执行完成：获取资源信息')};window.taskSniffEpisode=function(){sniffLog('开始执行任务：获取分集列表');sniffEpisode();sniffLog('任务执行完成：获取分集列表')};window.taskSniffPlayUrl=function(){sniffLog('开始执行任务：嗅探播放地址');sniffPlayUrl();sniffLog('任务执行完成：嗅探播放地址')};function sendResourceList(list){sendToFlutter({msgType:'resourceList',payload:list})}function sendEpisodeList(list){sendToFlutter({msgType:'episodeList',payload:list})}function sendSourceMap(map){sendToFlutter({msgType:'sourceMap',payload:map})}function sendM3U8Content(map){sendToFlutter({msgType:'m3u8Content',payload:map})}function sendPlayUrl(url){sendToFlutter({msgType:'playUrl',payload:String(url)})}function sendLoadIframe(url){sendToFlutter({msgType:'loadIframe',payload:String(url)})}window.__sniffBridgeInited=true}else{if(typeof sniffLog!=='undefined'){sniffLog('桥接脚本已存在，跳过重复注入')}}
